description: This file defines the interface IControlService for the Rialto server service, including method declarations for control management, acknowledgment, application state setting, and ping functionality.

classes.name: IControlService
classes.description: An interface class for control service operations in the Rialto server.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Adds a control with a specified ID and client.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Removes a control with the specified ID.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a control with a given ID and message ID.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Performs a ping operation with a given ID and acknowledgment sender.
